title: A unified solution framework for truck-and-drone routing problems
summary: Coordinated truck-and-drone routing integrates the high capacity and range of ground vehicles with the flexible routing and speed of drones, enabling simultaneous service. Increasingly applied in last-mile delivery, this synchronization helps reduce completion time and operational costs. To improve its efficiency, various coordination modes between trucks and drones have been proposed. Each mode accommodates diverse operational constraints tailored to particular delivery requirements.
